LanguageData.VGE_GenerateEmptyOrbitDesc: Open up an empty orbital map to build prefabs for export on.
LanguageData.VGE_FireBombardmentTargeterDesc: Fire {0} at target location. The gravship bombardment targeter will enter a brief cooldown period before it can be used to fire again.
LanguageData.VGE_NeedsLinkedTargetingTerminal: Can't fire: Needs a linked targeting terminal.
LanguageData.VGE_TargetingConsoleOnlyGravshipArtiller: Targeting console can only link with gravship artillery.
LanguageData.VGE_LinkWithTurretConsoleDesc: Select a turret to link with. This targeting console will be used to operate that turret.
LanguageData.VGE_UnlinkWithTurretConsoleDesc: Break the current link to a turret, allowing you to link with a different turret.
LanguageData.VGE_LinkWithTurretTargeterDesc: Select a turret to link with. This orbital targeter will be used to operate that turret.
LanguageData.VGE_UnlinkWithTurretTargeterDesc: Break the current link to a turret, allowing you to link with a different turret.
LanguageData.VGE_LaunchWarpodDesc: Launch this sub-orbital warpod towards a precise target destination.
LanguageData.VGE_WarpodLocationNeedRevealed: Can't launch warpods here: location needs to be revealed.
LanguageData.VGE_ShieldOverheated: Gravship shield generator has overheated due to lack of empty heatsinks. Consider building more heatsinks.
LanguageData.VGE_HackWarcomputer: Hack enemy warcomputer to retrieve gravdata
LanguageData.VGE_GravdataWillBeLostWarning: Gravdata obtained will be lost unless you select a gravtech research project.
LanguageData.VGE_WarcomputerHackedBlackBox: Hostile warcomputer hacked. {0} gravdata stored in the gravship black box.
LanguageData.VGE_WarcomputerHackedResearch: Hostile warcomputer hacked. {0} gravdata added to {1} research.
